title: Fontanini Foods, LLC Issues Voluntary Class I Recall of FONTANINI® Breakfast Pork Sausage Link
summary: The post Fontanini Foods, LLC Issues Voluntary Class I Recall of FONTANINI® Breakfast Pork Sausage Link appeared first on Hormel Foods .
body_markdown:
Fontanini Foods, LLC is voluntarily recalling 232 cases or 2,320 total pounds of FONTANINI® breakfast pork sausage link that has an establishment number of 6944 sent to foodservice operators throughout the United States as they may be contaminated with foreign material, specifically clear, hard plastic. No other FONTANINI® products are affected, and no illnesses or injuries have been reported in association with this recall.


This product is only sold to foodservice customers and cannot be purchased directly by consumers. All customers that received the affected product have been properly notified.


Products subject to this recall action:


FONTANINI® ITEM PRODUCT DESCRIPTION LABEL DATE


82339 FONTANINI® Breakfast Pork Sausage Link, Collagen Casing, Raw, 2 oz., 1/10 lb 6/23/2026


Complete details regarding the recall of this product, including the product case labels, are below.


Fontanini Foods, LLC is issuing the recall to ensure that customers are made aware of the issue. This recall is being made with the knowledge of the USDA Food Safety and Inspection Service (FSIS).
